_about: A model of the Claims deployment pipeline. stages lists the stages in order. assignments maps each stage to a workspace. rules lists deployment rules as {stage, item, rule, value}, where rule is data source, parameter or default lakehouse. rule_support says, for each item type, which rule types it takes (true or false). expectations records what you expect to happen.
needs: Four stages: Development, Test, UAT and Production.
In each later stage, Score claims uses that stage's own lakehouse: ClaimsLH_Test, ClaimsLH_UAT and ClaimsLH_Prod.
In each later stage, Claims mirror mirrors that stage's own Azure SQL Database: sql-claims-test, sql-claims-uat and sql-claims-prod.

items.Score claims: Notebook owned by Priya. Its default lakehouse in Development is ClaimsLH_Dev.
items.Claims mirror: Mirrored database owned by Priya. In Development it mirrors the Azure SQL Database sql-claims-dev.
items.ClaimsLH_Dev: Lakehouse in Development. Every later stage has its own lakehouse.

workspaces.Claims-Dev: On an F64 capacity. Nora is its admin.
workspaces.Claims-Test: On an F64 capacity. Nora is its admin.
workspaces.Claims-UAT-Old: On an F64 capacity. Already assigned to the Policy deployment pipeline.
workspaces.Claims-UAT: On an F64 capacity. Nora is its admin. Not in any pipeline.
workspaces.Claims-Prod-Pro: On a Pro license, not a Fabric capacity. Nora is its admin.
workspaces.Claims-Prod: On an F64 capacity. Nora is its admin. Omar is a contributor.

people.Nora: Pipeline admin. Admin of every Claims workspace except Claims-UAT-Old.
people.Omar: Pipeline admin. Contributor in Claims-Test and Claims-Prod. Viewer in Claims-UAT.
people.Priya: Owns Score claims and Claims mirror. Contributor in every Claims workspace.

expectations.rules_take_effect: the next time you deploy to that stage

who_creates_the_rules: any contributor in the target workspace
